archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Modern Minimalist (Audio Telephony SaaS)

theme_strategy.implementation_notes: Dark mode is the primary anchor default as requested. Light mode remains fully supported via html[data-civr-theme='light']. Switching operates via localStorage civr.theme and updates document.documentElement.dataset.civrTheme.

hierarchy.h1_hero_page: font-display text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: font-display text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug

rules: Headings use Barlow Condensed or DM Sans with bold weights, tight letter spacing, and never default to unstyled sans.
Telephony numbers, currencies, and timestamps strictly utilize JetBrains Mono with tabular numbers.
No text size smaller than 12px anywhere in the app to maintain WCAG legibility.
Heading to subtitle jump must never exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind 8pt scale: p-2 (8px), p-4 (16px), p-6 (24px), p-8 (32px), p-12 (48px)
layout_and_spacing.page_padding: px-4 sm:px-6 md:px-10 pt-5 md:pt-8 pb-32 lg:pb-16
box_border_reduction_strategy: Eliminate heavy double borders and nested boxes: Replace outer-border + inner-border card nesting with seamless hairline dividers (border-b border-[var(--c-hairline)]) and subtle background tint shifts.

Cardless deconstruction on dashboard: Replace the 4 chunky stat boxes with an integrated linear ribbon or bento stat bar featuring quiet icons, prominent values, and no thick surrounding bounding boxes.

Number cards declutter: Group and tuck secondary feature badges (Calls, Voicemail, Preview, Add Texting, Forwarding, IVR, Hours, Fax) into a clean primary row status + secondary popover/accordion drawer.
Single obvious action: Restrict each card and page to ONE primary CTA button (.civr-btn-primary). Demote secondary options to ghost (.civr-btn-ghost), text links, or an ellipsis action menu.
Hairline borders (1px with 8% opacity in dark theme, #e2e8f0 in light) to remove the 'grid cage' look.

civr_card.style: background: var(--c-card); border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;

civr_btn.style: min-height: 44px; border-radius: var(--radius-ctl); padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
civr_btn.primary_hover: background: var(--c-accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.7);
civr_btn.ghost: background: transparent; color: var(--c-text-2); border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
civr_btn.ghost_hover: background: var(--c-accent-soft); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: var(--c-accent);

civr_pill.style: min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); background: var(--c-surface-2); color: var(--c-text-2);
civr_pill.pill_on: background: var(--c-accent-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent) 40%, transparent); color: var(--c-accent);
civr_pill.pill_ok: background: var(--c-success-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-success) 40%, transparent); color: var(--c-success);
civr_pill.pill_warn: background: var(--c-warning-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-warning) 40%, transparent); color: var(--c-warning);
civr_pill.pill_bad: background: var(--c-danger-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-danger) 40%, transparent); color: var(--c-danger);

civr_input.style: min-height: 44px; border-radius: var(--radius-ctl); padding: 0 14px; font-size: 15px; background: var(--c-surface-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--c-border); color: var(--c-text); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
civr_input.focus: outline: none; border-color: var(--c-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-ring);

dashboard_stats_strip.style: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: var(--c-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
dashboard_stats_strip.stat_item: padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; hover:bg-[var(--c-surface-2)];
dashboard_stats_strip.stat_value: font-mono text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--c-text)] mt-1

refreshed_structure.header: Clean flex row: Flag + Mono phone number + Status Pill (Top). Quiet subtitle with country and plan name.
refreshed_structure.badges_reduction: Display ONLY primary capabilities (Calls / Texts / Fax) as compact icons/pills. Avoid stacking 8 separate badges.
refreshed_structure.switches_collapse: Group quick-switches into an unobtrusive drawer or 1-tap popover so card heights stay slim and uniform.
refreshed_structure.primary_action: Single obvious 'Settings' or 'Manage' ghost button with clear Chevron indicator, alongside an icon button for copy/actions.

number_detail_tabs.style: Segmented rounded pill group with active highlight, horizontal swipeable overflow without scrollbar, clear touch targets min 44px on mobile.

mobile_navigation_refinement.style: position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 40; height: calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: rgba(12, 14, 18, 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
mobile_navigation_refinement.thumb_reach_action: High-priority items (Home, Numbers, Inbox, Wallet, More) have 48px+ touch targets centered for easy one-hand thumb activation.
mobile_navigation_refinement.floating_action_safe_area: Main forms and dialers maintain padding-bottom to avoid overlap with bottom nav.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on Mobile Bottom Nav and TopBar: backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-hairline); Never use 100% transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle 4% noise overlay (.civr-grain) for analog warmth, preventing sterile flat digital appearance.

motion_and_micro_interactions.entry_animation: civrRise: opacity 0 -> 1, transform translateY(10px) -> translateY(0) in 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)
motion_and_micro_interactions.hover_lift: Interactive cards and primary buttons lift by -1px on hover with smooth shadow expansion.

accessibility_and_wcag.contrast_ratio: APCA & WCAG AA certified: Body text #c2cbdb against #0c0e12 (>7:1), Headings #f3f5f8 (>12:1), Accent #3b82f6 against dark surface (>4.5:1).
accessibility_and_wcag.touch_targets: Strict 44x44px minimum for all buttons, inputs, segmented tabs, and phone icons on mobile.
accessibility_and_wcag.focus_visibility: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } on every interactive node.
accessibility_and_wcag.testing_data_testids: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and informational numbers MUST retain or declare descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

avatars.description: Clean portrait avatar for signed-in account menu
Friendly support agent avatar for in-app support drawer

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all existing route logic and JS component files (.js not .tsx) intact; achieve maximum refresh primarily through /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/theme-2026.css and theme tokens.
2. Ensure Dark theme is the default experience in localStorage civr.theme and theme.js while maintaining flawless light theme token pairing.
3. Replace the boxy number cards by updating .civr-card styling: hairline borders, calm dark slate background (#13171f), clean layout, removing heavy box shadows and redundant badges.
4. Refactor the 4-box Dashboard stats into a sleek unified stat ribbon (.civr-stats) to eliminate box clutter and heavy boundaries.
5. Enforce single obvious main action hierarchy on cards and headers (.civr-btn-primary for the primary next step, .civr-btn-ghost for all others).
6. Improve mobile phone usability by ensuring minimum 44px tap targets, thumb-accessible bottom tab bar with crystal glassmorphism, and responsive padding.
7. Never remove or alter existing data-testid attributes across any components.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered templates and uniform gray boxes. Emphasize crisp Swiss typographic hierarchy, tactical spacing, and precise hairline separators.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.gradient_policy: NO full-screen muddy gradients. Use subtle dark solid planes with subtle accent glowing highlights (<15% opacity).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transition_policy: NO universal transition: all. Target specific properties: transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_preservation: All tests rely on kebab-case data-testid attributes. Never break existing test hooks.
